## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector breadth (7/11) and major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT surge vs AAPL/NVDA/AMD weakness) — suppresss strong regime calls. Sector-level breadth (approx): Consumer Disc: 9/14 positive; Communication: 7/10 positive; Technology: 14/24 positive; Financials: 13/20 positive; Healthcare: 11/17 positive; Energy: 7/10 positive; Materials: 3/11 positive; Industrials: 5/15 positive; Real Estate: 3/10 positive; Utilities: 2/10 positive.  

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary lead: AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND and BKNG (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on 1W movers: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate lagging with mixed earnings flow: VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION and WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION. Industrials under pressure: CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated across Materials/Real Estate and select mega-cap Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: MSFT (1W: +21.75%), CHTR (1W: +17.57%), AMZN (1W: +17.00%), ORCL (1W: +12.94%), ACN (1W: +12.88%) — watch ORCL/GOOGL RECOVERY setups. Major divergence flagged: several mega-caps show conflicting 1W vs 1M signals (MSFT surge vs AAPL/NVDA/AMD weakness) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: heavy short-term strength among platform and software names but notable laggards. MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +11.24% | 1M: +18.69%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND versus ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND and QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth (approx): 14/24 positive — internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive but mixed internals: V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth (approx): 13/20 positive — favors selective Financials.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious: pockets of strength but several large caps correcting. PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.95% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth (approx): 11/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to pockets of Financials and the specific Tech names leading the 1W move while reducing exposure to the weakest Industrials and lagging semiconductors. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat recent mega-cap dispersion as tactical rather than structural.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary and select Technology names on momentum (sector breadth approx: Consumer Disc 9/14 positive; Tech 14/24 positive). BEARISH: Utilities and Real Estate where earnings/technical pressure is showing (Utilities approx 2/10 positive; Real Estate approx 3/10 positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch MSFT continuation above recent breakout (confirm ABOVE TREND sustain), AAPL weakness failing the 1M area as a sign that CORRECTION deepens, NVDA failing short-term support would signal broader chip risk; ORCL/GOOGL follow-through on RECOVERY would validate rotation into software/platforms.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
VTR (+80): Ventas (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION — bullish Q2/guide but price is down, a divergence to monitor for mean reversion. (Only VTR from the bullish news list overlaps available returns and shows a news/price divergence.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): Apple (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION — KeyBanc downside warning aligns with 1W weakness, sentiment confirming price caution. BA (-55): Boeing (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.12%) RECOVERY — bearish news on B-52 cost overruns contrasts with short-term bounce, watch follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) showing relative strength. Key risk: pronounced mega-cap divergence (MSFT surge vs AAPL/NVDA/AMD weakness) and bearish headlines on AAPL that could widen the split — monitor for trend confirmation.
